 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Identify the solid 2 boundary and the distinct colored figure.
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in g[r])]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    if not pts:
        return g
    # Move the figure toward the 2 boundary until its bounding box touches it;
    # draw the 8 separator on the opposite side of the moved figure.
    if hr:
        boundary = hr[0]
        minr, maxr = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
        dr = boundary - 1 - maxr if maxr < boundary else boundary + 1 - minr
        line = minr + dr - 1 if maxr < boundary else maxr + dr + 1
        for r,c in pts: g[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in pts: g[r+dr][c] = grid[r][c]
        for c in range(w): g[line][c] = 8
    elif vc:
        boundary = vc[0]
        minc, maxc = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
        dc = boundary - 1 - maxc if maxc < boundary else boundary + 1 - minc
        line = minc + dc - 1 if maxc < boundary else maxc + dc + 1
        for r,c in pts: g[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in pts: g[r][c+dc] = grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h): g[r][line] = 8
    return g
